architectural_fidelity.reason: Same room recognizable: walls, ceiling height, window position/size preserved, camera viewpoint maintained, no added walls

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed with no ghost outlines, remnants, or phantom shadows visible

style_commitment.reason: Strong bohemian commitment evident through macramé wall hanging, patterned curtains, layered textiles, brass fixtures, natural materials, and curated gallery wall—not generic neutral

editorial_density.reason: Multiple styled vignettes: gallery wall with 4+ frames, macramé textile art, console table styling, throw blanket, decorative pouf, plants, dual-head brass lamp, tasseled runner rug—matches AD-level richness

photorealism.reason: Coherent natural lighting from windows, realistic material textures on fabrics/wood/metal, proper shadows, no CGI plasticity—highly believable render

designer_preference_reason: Cova delivers strong stylistic identity with bohemian authenticity while Collov's bedroom examples (though high quality) show generic contemporary staging unsuitable for this living room context.
what_cova_does_better: Authentic bohemian style execution with signature elements like macramé and textured textiles
Appropriate living room furniture layout versus bedroom comparison
Warm, lived-in aesthetic with layered accessories and personal touches
Natural material palette with brass, wood, and woven textures
what_collov_does_better: Examples shown are different room type (bedroom vs living room) making direct comparison unfair
Ceiling fan addition in Collov examples shows willingness to add architectural elements
